entry.name: listbox
entry.digest: Display and output numbers, lists, and messages
entry.description: The number object displays and outputs either integers, floats, lists of numbers, or any message, depending on its format. flonum is a synonym for number in Float format, listbox is a synonym for number in List format, and textbox is a synonym for number in Text format.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Clicking and dragging up and down on abox with the mouse (when the patcher window is locked) moves the displayed value up and down, and outputs the new values continuously.In a float number box, dragging to the left of the decimal point changes the value in increments of 1. Dragging to the right of the decimal point changes the fractional part of the number in increments of 0.01.When the active patcher window is locked, numbers can be entered into a number box by clicking on it with the mouse and typing in a number on the computer keyboard. Typing the Return or Enter keys on Macintosh or the Enter key on Windows, or clicking outside the number box, sends the number out the outlet. You can also click on the number box and use the up or down arrows on your keyboard to increase or decrease the number by one. Shift+arrow jumps by tens. For the float number box, alt/option+arrow jumps by tenths.When theof thebox is set to List, you can drag up or down on individual numbers within the list to change them.When theof thebox is set to List or Text, you can select individual items in a list or message to replace them by typing, or select the entire contents to replace everything by typing.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: If any message is received and thebox'sis set to Text, the entire message is stored and output. If theis set to Int or Float, an error message is posted to the Max console and no value is stored or output. If theis set to List, no value is stored or output, but no error message is posted.

messages.name: max
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the maximum value that can be displayed or sent out by thebox. The wordby itself sets the maximum to None, removing any previously set maximum value.

messages.name: min
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the minimum value that can be displayed or sent out by thebox. The wordby itself sets the minimum to None, removing any previously set minimum value.

messages.name: select
messages.description: The wordwill highlight the number box so you can type values into it. Clicking on any empty space in a locked patcher will deselect the object.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the value with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, list or message, sets the stored and displayed value to that number without triggering output.
